description: Soul System — the pre-completion verification gate (SOUL-F012). Fires on Stop; self-scopes to Soul-governed projects and injects the completion checklist before a session ends after shipping. SessionStart arms the EXPERIMENTAL secret guard (SOUL-I070): it points git's core.hooksPath at the plugin's read-only hook wrappers for every git the session runs, so git itself checks each commit and push (credentials block, private names warn) and then runs the repo's own hooks; it verifies the arming and says NOT armed when it fails. PreToolUse on Bash re-verifies the wrapper folder (reinstalling it if missing or modified), notices commands that bypass git hooks or run hook installers, and refuses `git push --all / --branches / --tags / --mirror` run at a command position. SessionStart also reports a Soul vault link (SOUL-I079): one context line when `.soul` links into the vault, and a loud warning when that link is broken — a broken link turns the gate off and git stays quiet. Upkeep (SOUL-A032): a second Stop hook, hooks/upkeep.py, asks the session once to refresh the handoff cursor with /soul-handoff when about 100,000 tokens of conversation or a summary have passed since it was last written, and a SessionStart hook on `compact` says to refresh it first; both are silent outside Soul projects, before a first cursor exists, and when .soul/init.md says `upkeep: off`.
